name: How long does a metal-building condensation assessment take?
description: The on-site inspection takes one to three hours, with a written findings summary and corrective plan typically provided within several business days.

mainEntity.name: How long does a metal-building condensation assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: An assessment usually takes one to three hours on-site, depending on the building square footage and eave height. A comprehensive findings summary with corrective recommendations is typically delivered within a few business days. Total project turnaround depends on whether mechanical ventilation testing or seasonal monitoring is required to capture severe temperature differentials between indoor work areas and outdoor air.
